### Added
- **The CLI sign-in can print the URL instead of opening a browser, and honors `$BROWSER`.** A sign-in always launched the platform opener (`xdg-open`, `open`, `start`) and printed the URL only when the opener failed, so a session driving its own browser never saw the URL. `--no-browser` on the login command, or `MUSTER_NO_BROWSER=1` for every command that signs in, starts no browser process: the authorization URL goes to stdout and the CLI keeps waiting for the callback until the URL is opened elsewhere on the machine. Otherwise the commands in `$BROWSER` are tried before the platform default. ([#1425](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/issues/1425))
